finding: The one-retry control rule was incorrectly applied to idempotent initialization. Two typed TLS deadlines before HTTP dispatch stopped startup while the guest was still booting, before the existing three-minute startup window elapsed. This is a runner regression, not a CDS result.
follow_up: Restore the original bounded startup window only for idempotent init. Preserve one tunnel restart for workload phases and fail on uncertain dispatch or a returned receipt. The new regression test requires initialization to survive multiple pre-dispatch deadlines.
